text: Instant Pot Honey Garlic Chicken. Sweet, sticky, and the pot does the work. You take the credit.
Eleven ingredients. Most of them are already in your pantry, judging you.
Step one. Honey, garlic, soy, ketchup, oregano, parsley. Mix it in a bowl. Yes, this one gets a bowl.
Sauté mode. Sesame oil. Stand back.
Salt and pepper the thighs, then brown them, two to three minutes a side. Don't poke them. We said what we said.
Pour in the sauce. Lock the lid. No peeking.
Poultry setting, twenty minutes. Go sit down.
Let the pressure come down for five minutes. Opening it early is not on the menu.
Plate it, sauce it, sesame seeds and green onions on top. Ranch is not invited.
